channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Evan Turner | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Evan Turner from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Evan Turner
item.description:
He’s still not going to take minutes away from the regulars when (if?) the team is fully healthy, but there might be some times where he gets the call over Grant Williams or Semi Ojeleye.

“We're hoping that we can do with Jabari a little bit like we did with Evan Turner,”

Danny Ainge on Evan Turner, Apr 23, 2021. Source: Boston Sports Journal.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Evan Turner
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Brad Stevens on Evan Turner joining the Celtics staff:

“He will be sometime in the next couple of weeks. He's a special guy. Obviously a really good player in a lot of places. ... Just loves to be around the game and loves to help people. ... He's a team guy.”

Brad Stevens on Evan Turner, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Evan Turner
item.description:
Travis Schlenk on Evan Turner:

“We are happy to add Evan to our team, a veteran who we believe can help our club. The versatility he has shown throughout his career will be valuable for us this season.”

Travis Schlenk on Evan Turner, Jun 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @CVivlamoreAJC.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Evan Turner, Al-Farouq Aminu, Damian Lillard, Moe Harkless, CJ McCollum
item.description:
Brad Stevens on #Blazers:

“You start with how special (Lillard & McCollum) are offensively, but Harkless, Aminu & Turner shooting the ball has really helped. They have a lot of guys you can go to, a lot of efficient players at offensive end & versatile players at defensive end.”

Brad Stevens on Evan Turner, Al-Farouq Aminu, Damian Lillard, Moe Harkless, CJ McCollum, Mar 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Evan Turner
item.description:
Jay King:Isaiah Thomas on good friend Evan Turner:

“I was busting his ass, so I was letting him know about that.”

Isaiah Thomas on Evan Turner, Jan 21, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Evan Turner
item.description:
Brian Robb:Brad Stevens on Evan Turner's new contract:

“When I saw that and came across the deal, I was so happy for him.”

Brad Stevens on Evan Turner, Jul 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Evan Turner
item.description:
Brian Robb:Danny Ainge on Evan Turner:

“I think Evan was really good for us and a very good player. I'm just really happy for him, I think it's a great situation.”

Danny Ainge on Evan Turner, Jul 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Evan Turner
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Stevens on today's lineup:

“I'm gonna go back w/ Evan Turner at the 1. We've had success in the games he's started. We're still searching.”

Brad Stevens on Evan Turner, Dec 31, 2014. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Larry Bird on Evan Turner
item.description:
Scott Agness:Bird on Turner:

“I love his game because he can do a little bit of everything. Wherever he’s at next year, he’ll average 17.”

Larry Bird on Evan Turner, Jun 2, 2014. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Evan Turner
item.description:
Christopher A. Vito:#Pacers coach Frank Vogel:

“I don’t know where (Evan Turner) was a few years ago, but he’s definitely a complete player now.”

Frank Vogel on Evan Turner, Mar 14, 2014. Source: Twitter @ChrisVito.
